items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: You and Jason Berry and I are very, very good friends.

ctx.x: Well, was there a name for the organization?

Uh, I'm trying to think of the name. It was called the New Orleans Political Association. I think, I think that's the name I remember. But we had another, another name. I, I think the name was changed somewhere in time. And, uh, I left town. I went over to Texas on a trip or something like that and stayed over there for a while. When I came back, the name was changed. But, uh, some of the same people were active. Some of the same people died into it. Then, along came, uh, Ernest Wright, uh, who was one of the…
Gee, I want to get back to something. Well, we've been showing this. You showed me this thing. It's about the reception. It's a brochure.
